SUMMARY.md: English name of the language, for example `German`.

The JSON language list published by `www.gnome.org`. Knowledge comes from the community Swift client https://github.com/l0v3m0n3y/gnome (src/gnome.swift, whose `getSupportedLanguages` is the README example) and from a live GET probe on 2026-10-23 (38 languages). That client also calls four other hosts (`extensions.gnome.org`, `discourse.gnome.org`, flathub.org and `docs.gtk.org`); they are separate origins that one server URL cannot reach, so they are not modelled here, and its Flathub search is a POST. No key is needed. Nothing else on `www.gnome.org` was found to serve JSON (`/wp-json/` is 404).
